title: The longest wingspan ever flown
text: The Stratolaunch Roc, which has the longest wingspan ever flown at 385 feet, first flew from Mojave Air and Space Port on April 13, 2019. Its twin fuselages are each 238 feet long, and it is powered by six Pratt and Whitney engines. About half of its empty weight comes from parts of a Boeing 747-400. It was designed to carry rockets aloft for launch into orbit, and it has since carried a hypersonic test vehicle.
